howMeasured.readiness: The main score comes from the brand when it shares one (Garmin's Body Battery, on its original 5–100 scale). When it does not, we show the Ultra Hero Daily Balance: it compares your overnight HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, load and temperature with your last 28 days.
howMeasured.sleep: The watch detects sleep from movement and heart rate. A night belongs to the day you wake up. With Apple Watch, time in bed does not show: that comes from the iPhone, not the watch.
howMeasured.vitals: Night signals compares resting heart rate, HRV, breathing, SpO₂ and overnight temperature with your usual range (median ± spread of the last 28 days). Only readings taken during sleep count; with fewer than 2 HRV readings in the night, the value is not shown.
howMeasured.activity: Steps, distance and calories come only from the watch (the phone is not added). Goals are the watch's own; Ultra Hero does not suggest goals.
howMeasured.workouts: Only workouts started or detected on the watch count; typed or web-uploaded workouts are left out. The day load adds the minutes in each heart-rate zone × the zone number (Edwards TRIMP).
howMeasured.stress: Stress is measured by Garmin from heart-rate variability, from 0 to 100, while you are still. We show Garmin's own scale and levels.
howMeasured.environment: Environmental noise and time in daylight are measured by Apple Watch when those features are turned on in the watch settings.

vendorOnly.apple: Apple: Readiness (Series 12 and Ultra 4), Sleep Score, Vitals alerts and Training Load.
vendorOnly.garmin: Garmin: Training Readiness, Training Status, acute load and load focus, recovery time, HRV Status, Health Status, Sleep Coach, Training Effect, Endurance and Hill Score, race predictions, lactate threshold, FTP and Morning Report.
vendorOnly.samsung: Samsung: Energy Score, Vascular Load and Bedtime Guidance; through Health Connect, HRV, resting heart rate, temperature, breathing and floors do not arrive either.
vendorOnly.google: Google: Daily Readiness, Cardio Load, Target Load and Health Guardian.
vendorOnly.whoop: WHOOP: Healthspan, Stress Monitor and BP Insights.
